name: SPL - Splunk Processing Language Fundamentals
command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | stats count by ParentImage, Image
description: Splunk Processing Language (SPL) cheatsheet covering all core commands used in SOC threat hunting and intrusion detection. Covers search, fields, table, stats, chart, eval, rex, lookup, transaction, and subsearch patterns against Windows Security and Sysmon indexes.
source: CDSA Module 05: Understanding Log Sources & Investigating with Splunk
notes:
Splunk URL: http://<TARGET_IP>:8000 → Search & Reporting
Index used in examples: main (Windows Security + Sysmon logs)

=== Basic Search ===
  index="main" "UNKNOWN"                    keyword search (implicit AND)
  index="main" "*UNKNOWN*"                  wildcard (SLOW — avoid leading *)
  index="main" ComputerName="*uniwaldo.local"  field-targeted (FAST)
  index="main" EventCode!=1                 comparison operator
  index="main" earliest=-7d EventCode!=1    time-relative filter
  index="main" earliest=0                   all time

=== fields — include/exclude columns ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | fields - User
  (minus = exclude; no minus = include only those fields)

=== table — format output as table ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | table _time, host, Image

=== rename — rename a field ===
  ... | rename Image as Process

=== dedup — remove duplicates ===
  ... EventCode=1 | dedup Image
  ... | dedup filename, is_malware

=== sort — sort results ===
  ... | sort - _time           descending by time
  ... | sort - count           descending by count

=== stats — aggregate statistics ===
  ... EventCode=1 | stats count by ParentImage, Image
  ... EventCode=3 | stats count by _time, Image
  ... | stats count by sourcetype

=== chart — pivot-style table ===
  ... EventCode=3 | chart count by _time, Image
  (each Image gets its own column)

=== eval — create/modify fields ===
  ... EventCode=1 | eval Process_Path=lower(Image)
  ... Image=*cmd.exe | eval len=len(CommandLine) | table User, len, CommandLine | sort - len

=== rex — regex field extraction ===
  index="main" EventCode=4662 | rex max_match=0 "[^%](?<guid>{.*})" | table guid
  (max_match=0 = extract all occurrences)

=== lookup — enrich with CSV data ===
  ... EventCode=1 | rex field=Image "(?P<filename>[^\\\\]+)$" | eval filename=lower(filename) | lookup malware_lookup.csv filename OUTPUTNEW is_malware | table filename, is_malware
  ... EventCode=1 | eval filename=mvindex(mvdedup(split(Image,"\\\\")), -1) | eval filename=lower(filename) | lookup malware_lookup.csv filename OUTPUTNEW is_malware | table filename, is_malware | dedup filename, is_malware

=== inputlookup — read lookup file directly ===
  | inputlookup malware_lookup.csv

=== transaction — group related events into sessions ===
  ... (EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3) | transaction Image startswith=eval(EventCode=1) endswith=eval(EventCode=3) maxspan=1m | table Image | dedup Image
  # Groups process-create + network-connect by same Image within 1 minute

=== subsearch — nested search ===
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 NOT [ search index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | top limit=100 Image | fields Image ] | table _time, Image, CommandLine, User, ComputerName
  # Returns rare/unusual processes (not in top 100)

=== Splunk Sourcetypes (Windows) ===
  WinEventLog:Security    → Windows Security events (4624, 4625, 4662, etc.)
  WinEventLog:Sysmon      → Sysmon events (EventCode 1-25)
  WinEventLog:System      → System events (7045)
  WinEventLog:Application → Application events
  linux:syslog            → Linux syslog

=== Performance Tips ===
  Use field= searches over wildcards: ComputerName="*x" is MUCH faster than searching *x*
  Target specific sourcetype to narrow scope early in the pipeline
  Use earliest= to limit time range before piping

examples.label: List all Sysmon EventCodes in the index
examples.command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" | stats count by EventCode

examples.label: All sourcetypes available in the main index
All parent-child process creation events (Sysmon Event 1)
examples.command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | stats count by ParentImage, Image

examples.label: Filter parent-child to cmd.exe and powershell.exe children only
examples.command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 (Image="*cmd.exe" OR Image="*powershell.exe") | stats count by ParentImage, Image

examples.label: Transaction: correlate process create → network connect within 1 minute
examples.command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" (EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3) | transaction Image startswith=eval(EventCode=1) endswith=eval(EventCode=3) maxspan=1m | table Image | dedup Image

examples.label: Rare/unusual processes — NOT in top 100 most common
examples.command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 NOT [ search index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | top limit=100 Image | fields Image ] | table _time, Image, CommandLine, User, ComputerName

examples.label: Rex: extract GUIDs from Event 4662 (DCSync detection)
examples.command: index="main" EventCode=4662 | rex max_match=0 "[^%](?<guid>{.*})" | table guid

examples.label: Lookup: match process names against malware CSV list
examples.command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | rex field=Image "(?P<filename>[^\\]+)$" | eval filename=lower(filename) | lookup malware_lookup.csv filename OUTPUTNEW is_malware | table filename, is_malware
